sents.zh: 明朝有两个人，一生都在找答案。
sents.en: Two men of the Ming spent their lives looking for answers.

sents.zh: 第一个人很喜欢山上的草和树。
sents.en: The first loved the plants and trees of the hills.

sents.zh: 他想知道哪些可以做药。
sents.en: He wanted to know which of them could be medicine.

sents.zh: 因为以前的书里有很多不对的地方。
sents.en: Because the old books had a great deal that was wrong.
So he decided to go and see for himself.

sents.zh: 他走了很多路，问了很多人。
sents.en: He walked a great deal and asked a great many people.
He also tried some of the plants himself.

sents.zh: 他用了差不多三十年，写成了一本很大的书。
sents.en: He spent nearly thirty years and wrote a great book.

sents.zh: 书里有一千多种草和药。
sents.en: In it were more than a thousand kinds of plant and medicine.

sents.zh: 第二个人喜欢走路，也喜欢看山看水。
sents.en: The second loved walking, and looking at mountains and rivers.

sents.zh: 他去了很多别人没有去过的地方。
sents.en: He went to many places no one else had been.

sents.zh: 有的路很难走，他也没有回去。
sents.en: Some paths were hard going, but he did not turn back.

sents.zh: 他每天晚上都写下白天看到的东西。
sents.en: Every evening he wrote down what he had seen that day.

sents.zh: 他写了几十年，写了很多本。
sents.en: He wrote for decades, filling many volumes.

sents.zh: 他们两个人做的事情一样：自己去看，然后写下来。
sents.en: Both men did the same thing: go and see for themselves, then write it down.
